courses.name: Social Psychology
courses.contribution: Complementary behavioural foundations: scientific social psychology examines how the presence of others shapes thought, feelings and behaviour; application to citizen behaviour is supplied by the programme.

courses.name: The Art of Rhetorical Communication
courses.contribution: Complementary academic and professional communication: rhetorical analysis, argument, writing and oral presentation support public and organisational communication; no dedicated policy-advice project is guaranteed.

courses.name: Communicating the Climate Crisis
courses.contribution: examines how climate problems are framed and communicated to publics

courses.name: Persuasive Communication
courses.contribution: Direct public-communication method: framing, nudging, cognitive shortcuts and persuasion ethics are applied in a local-institution communication project. This supports the communication dimension of advice, not the whole policy-advising process.

courses.name: Introduction to Public International Law
courses.contribution: Direct public-law context: sources and institutions of public international law, state authority, treaties, compliance, refugee and environmental law support analysis of public organisations beyond the national state. This does not reproduce comparative public-administration practice.
